##### Project general facts

Jasmine Lane by Durar Group is a luxurious gated residential project where world-renowned fashion icon Elie Saab has breathed life into every space, blending modern architectural details with a splendid community setting. The development offers a collection of spacious and elegantly designed villas and townhouses, each one framed by lush greenery, elevated landscaped gardens and beautifully lit private streets. Homes come with generous terraces, private backyards, covered parking and their own outdoor entertainment areas, creating a superior standard of living where elegance truly flourishes and indulging comfort shapes everyday life.

The community is equipped with state-of-the-art amenities, headed by a welcoming club house that sits at the heart of the neighbourhood and opens straight onto the resort-style pool deck. Residents can swim in the junior and adult pools, train in both indoor and outdoor gyms, and unwind afterwards in the separate male and female steam rooms and saunas. A multipurpose court and basketball court add an energetic sporting dimension, while shaded sun loungers, palm-lined water features and beautifully manicured gardens make every day feel like a holiday.

Inside, the interiors are pure couture, with gleaming marble flooring, richly veined marble feature walls and softly panelled joinery that give each room a sense of quiet grandeur. The kitchens are exquisite, pairing handleless cabinetry with dramatic dark marble islands, fluted detailing, brass accents and integrated lighting that makes the stone glow. Bedrooms feature herringbone timber floors, upholstered headboards and elegant walk-in wardrobes, while the bathrooms combine textured stone, warm gold fittings and backlit mirrors, and bespoke ELIE SAAB monogrammed furnishings complete the look throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Golf Estates, an exclusive and opulent residential and leisure development in the southwestern part of Dubai, this exceptional location is renowned for its world-class golf facilities and opulent living spaces. The heart of the community is its two splendid championship golf courses, meticulously designed by golf legends Greg Norman and Pete Dye, with the Earth Course hosting the prestigious DP World Tour Championship.

The location is distinguished by its wealth of community amenities and facilities, including recreational spaces, fitness centers, and fine dining options, providing residents with a well-rounded and enjoyable lifestyle. The community's lush landscapes and serene environment create a peaceful retreat while remaining conveniently connected to Dubai's key destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modernist elegance, golf-course living, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Golf Estates delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class golf, luxurious living, and a prestigious address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of refined living.
